column3: “Jesus Christ in the flesh having come” is rendered “that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh.”
NASB follows the critical text (“does not confess Jesus,” without “Christ has come in the flesh”); it supplies “the spirit.”
“Falsehood” is rendered “error”; NASB writes “spirit of truth” in lowercase.
“Has not known” is rendered “does not know.”
“Among us” is rendered “in us,” and “the one and only” “only begotten.”
NASB follows the critical text (“we loved”); it supplies “to be.”
NASB follows the critical text (“Jesus,” without “Christ”).
NASB follows the critical text (“We love,” without “Him”).
NASB follows the critical text (“cannot love”).
